items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: I took up a course there with Marie Little

ctx.x: You weren't studying music then, here?

No, I didn't. I took up a course there with Marie Little, when she took over the thing on a band, in music arranging and public school music and all that stuff. But most of it I had already learned, 'cause Jack Washington was a graduate of Western University.
